SELECT $__timeInterval(Timestamp) AS ts,
  multiIf(notEmpty(SpanAttributes['dlightrag.error.kind']), SpanAttributes['dlightrag.error.kind'],
          StatusMessage ILIKE '%run_abandoned%' OR StatusMessage ILIKE '%abandoned%', 'run_abandoned',
          StatusMessage ILIKE '%dependency_unavailable%' OR StatusMessage ILIKE '%unavailable%', 'dependency_unavailable',
          empty(StatusMessage), '(no message)',
          'other') AS error_kind,
  count() AS errors
FROM $__sourceTable
WHERE startsWith(ServiceName, 'dlightrag')
  AND SpanName = 'run-answer'
  AND StatusCode = 'Error'
  AND $__timeFilter_ms(Timestamp)
  AND $__filters
GROUP BY ts, error_kind
ORDER BY ts
LIMIT 1000

SELECT ts, 1 - free / total AS memory_used
FROM (
  SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS ts,
         maxIf(Value, Attributes['state'] = 'free') AS free,
         sum(Value) AS total
  FROM $__sourceTable(sum)
  WHERE MetricName = 'system.memory.usage'
    AND $__timeFilter_ms(TimeUnix)
    AND $__filters
  GROUP BY ts
)
ORDER BY ts
LIMIT 1000

SELECT $__timeInterval(Timestamp) AS ts,
  SpanName AS span_name,
  sum(toUInt64OrZero(SpanAttributes['gen_ai.usage.cache_read.input_tokens']))
    / nullIf(sum(toUInt64OrZero(SpanAttributes['gen_ai.usage.input_tokens'])), 0) AS cache_hit_rate
FROM $__sourceTable
WHERE startsWith(ServiceName, 'dlightrag')
  AND SpanName != 'embed-text'
  AND SpanAttributes['gen_ai.usage.input_tokens'] != ''
  AND $__timeFilter_ms(Timestamp)
  AND $__filters
GROUP BY ts, span_name
ORDER BY ts
LIMIT 1000

SELECT $__timeInterval(Timestamp) AS ts,
  sum(toUInt64OrZero(SpanAttributes['gen_ai.usage.input_tokens']))
    - sum(toUInt64OrZero(SpanAttributes['gen_ai.usage.cache_read.input_tokens'])) AS fresh_tokens,
  sum(toUInt64OrZero(SpanAttributes['gen_ai.usage.cache_read.input_tokens'])) AS cached_tokens
FROM $__sourceTable
WHERE startsWith(ServiceName, 'dlightrag')
  AND SpanName != 'embed-text'
  AND $__timeFilter_ms(Timestamp)
  AND $__filters
GROUP BY ts
HAVING fresh_tokens > 0 OR cached_tokens > 0
ORDER BY ts
LIMIT 1000

SELECT $__timeInterval(Timestamp) AS ts,
  coalesce(nullIf(JSONExtractString(SpanAttributes['dlightrag.output'], 'web_search_provider'), ''), 'none') AS provider,
  countIf(JSONExtractBool(SpanAttributes['dlightrag.output'], 'web_search_degraded')) AS failed_over,
  count() AS calls
FROM $__sourceTable
WHERE startsWith(ServiceName, 'dlightrag')
  AND SpanName = 'execute-agent-tool'
  AND JSONHas(SpanAttributes['dlightrag.output'], 'web_search_provider')
  AND $__timeFilter_ms(Timestamp)
  AND $__filters
GROUP BY ts, provider
ORDER BY ts
LIMIT 1000

SELECT $__timeInterval(Timestamp) AS ts,
  sum(JSONExtractFloat(SpanAttributes['dlightrag.output'], 'web_search_cost_dollars')) AS cost_dollars,
  sum(JSONExtractUInt(SpanAttributes['dlightrag.output'], 'web_search_hits')) AS passages
FROM $__sourceTable
WHERE startsWith(ServiceName, 'dlightrag')
  AND SpanName = 'execute-agent-tool'
  AND JSONHas(SpanAttributes['dlightrag.output'], 'web_search_provider')
  AND $__timeFilter_ms(Timestamp)
  AND $__filters
GROUP BY ts
HAVING cost_dollars > 0 OR passages > 0
ORDER BY ts
LIMIT 1000
